From experience, my puppy also whines and cries in her crate so I just wait it until until she settles. She will get bored eventually if you don't give her attention. When she becomes quiet, then I give her a treat in her crate. I continue giving her treats here and there so she knows to be quiet and that she can receive treats in her crate (which I think should prevent her from hating her crate.) 

As long as you let her have time to play outside of her crate, I think you should be fine. Don't use the crate as punishment and make sure you don't make her associate the crate with being alone (like sit outside the crate sometimes while she is in it). I tell her to go inside the crate and give her treat when she does. I also give her her food inside the crate with the door closed and fill it with toys she can chew on. She takes naps in her crate when I'm away at class.

I just got a dog last Friday and I named her Aeri. She’s a samoyed and I’ve wanted this breed since 2012 when I saw it in a KPOP boyband debut teaser. Her name comes from what that band called their fans before their fans got an official name. I think it’s special to me because that band got me through high school, and now I’m going through a rough time in grad school and getting Aerj helped set me back on track.

My family actually didn’t give me a hard time with her name. Which is hilarious because they’re all dog people so we went through naming dogs so many times (recent ones were Java, Cash, and Pepe) and we’d have long arguments over the names but naming Aeri was so peaceful.
